Hi together,
I'm using Blebox integration for few days. It is working great but I have few issues where I need to help with.

When is configured in Blebox access management (defined username and password), the integration does not work anymore and I could not find any option where it is possible to add the credentials. HTTP error 401 (unauthorized access)

![Screenshot 2023-08-19 at 17 27 27](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/17861823/64db1d59-b6f9-4f04-967e-a698afc98ece)

Would it be also possible to change the STOP button for another icon and name. I use this for Walk-In function but it is a bit confusing in UI of the home assistant

![Screenshot 2023-08-19 at 17 26 16](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/assets/17861823/83aba8de-0b9d-4a2a-a86e-37e810dc9869)

Thank you,
